rules.title: Suspicious LSASS Memory Access via OpenProcess
rules.tuning_notes:
This rule requires environment-specific tuning:

1. FIRST DEPLOYMENT: Run in test/log-only mode for 7 days
2. Identify legitimate processes accessing LSASS in your environment
3. Add verified legitimate tools to appropriate filter sections
4. Document each exclusion with ticket/change request reference

Common additions:
- Endpoint management agents (SCCM, Intune, etc.)
- PAM solutions (CyberArk, BeyondTrust, etc.)
- Custom monitoring scripts (verify and whitelist by hash)

rules.title: PowerShell Execution with Encoded Command
rules.tuning_notes:
This rule has a MEDIUM false positive rate due to legitimate
automation use cases. Tune as follows:

1. Baseline your environment:
   - Run for 7 days in log-only mode
   - Identify recurring legitimate encoded command patterns

2. Add exclusions by:
   - Parent process (management tools)
   - Specific base64 patterns (if static)
   - Service accounts with documented automation

3. Consider splitting into HIGH and MEDIUM severity:
   - HIGH: Encoded + hidden window + execution bypass
   - MEDIUM: Encoded command only
